replace.place.plan:
Propose a bounded, numeric next placement step from selected current public RGB-D regions.
Use when: explicitly select the arm that holds or released this object; a retained object is near a visible destination and you need a preplace, lower, or short exit candidate. Select object_ref, then name the destination as flat fields: destination_kind, destination_support_ref, and destination_boundary_ref for open_container or front_cavity, which is refused by name when it is missing there and when it is supplied for support_surface. A whole-container centroid is not its cavity. Re-localize after every physical action.
Effect: read-only with respect to the world; creates an immutable observation-bound assessment, measured geometry and overlay. It consumes no robot decision, executes no motion and changes no action admission state. The original mask and depth are preserved as immutable evidence. In this placement-only projection, boundary discontinuity pixels are flagged uncertain, not certified background; the original depth remains available for inspection.
Returns: candidates, no_candidate or unknown with at most three one-step numeric sparse move_pose={targets:{selected_arm:{position_m,orientation_xyzw,interaction}}} candidates, checks, stage evidence and hashed public evidence. Copy an appropriate numeric target into move_pose only at this observation; after any physical step, re-observe and recompute. assessment_ref is an audit reference, never an executable trajectory. Inspect the reported depth-edge uncertainty: all retained points still face unchanged support/opening tests. When boundary evidence is unresolved, candidates are conditional on unresolved silhouette, not full-object fit, passage or release certificates.
Does not: prove object identity, grasp attachment, stable support, physical release or official success; infer hidden cavity volume; or certify a collision-free scene/payload trajectory. The existing RoboTwin motion route is unchanged; this tool adds no scene or carried-object collision model. No visible conflict is not collision-free. upright uses a fit to the selected visible circular rim, not a PCA cup axis; absent/invalid rim evidence stays unknown. Each protected_before_refs and protected_current_refs entry at the same index is an Agent association, not identity authentication. A boundary depth gap cannot distinguish leaked background from a true farther surface or thin handle; flagged pixels remain unresolved evidence, not semantic background exclusions.
On error: inspect fresh complementary RGB-D and reselect functional regions; do not replace missing geometry with a guessed center or stale candidate. Retention checks supply advisory geometric evidence; decide closed-gripper motion from fresh observations and the reported uncertainty. Placement sequence: check before release, make the release its own action, check again on a fresh observation after release, depart a short distance, then check once more. Which calls perform those steps is what this surface declares, and where a placement skill absorbs them they run as its stages; do not look for a call this surface does not advertise. Each check is evidence for Agent judgment, not an automatic release or success authorization.
Arm binding: every gripper command, retention check and placement check must name the intended arm, whichever calls this surface advertises for them. Opposite-arm opening does not release this object; opposite-arm motion is not this arm's exit. All candidates stale after any world action, including motion of the other arm. A successful gripper receipt says executed, not Cartesian reached; it is command completion, not physical release. geometry_status and measured checks are separate from stage_evidence and uncertainty_reasons. Unconfirmed action stage preserves valid geometric candidates; inspect their prerequisites and decide subsequent actions independently.
replace.place.verify:
Assess current visible placement relations separately before release, after release, and after departure.
Use when: explicitly select the arm that holds or released this object; at pre_release before independently opening, at post_release with fresh regions after opening, or at post_exit after a short departure. Select the current object, then name the destination as destination_kind, destination_support_ref and, for open_container or front_cavity, destination_boundary_ref; a whole-container centroid is not its cavity. Pass protected regions as index-aligned protected_before_refs and protected_current_refs of equal length, and use them or prior_assessment_ref only for the declared comparison.
Effect: read-only with respect to the world; records one immutable assessment and overlay from public RGB-D and actual action receipts. It consumes no robot decision and does not open, retreat, wait, move or change action admission state. The original mask and depth are preserved as immutable evidence. In this placement-only projection, boundary discontinuity pixels are flagged uncertain, not certified background; the original depth remains available for inspection.
Returns: consistent, contradicted or unknown with separate region, support, orientation and protected-object checks, receipt-derived stage evidence, measurements, selected-region hashes and evidence hashes. consistent means compatibility with the stated visible checks, not attachment, stable support, actual release, permission to release or official success. Inspect the reported depth-edge uncertainty: all retained points still face unchanged support/opening tests. Compatibility is conditional evidence; related place.plan candidates are conditional on unresolved silhouette, not full-object fit, passage or release certificates.
Does not: accept user claims of released/stable state, authenticate selected object identities, infer an invisible support or cavity, or use object ground truth/contact forces. upright measures the selected visible circular rim normal, never a PCA cup axis; without admissible rim evidence it is unknown. Agent-chosen protected_before_refs and protected_current_refs pairs do not establish identity. The absence of a visible conflict does not certify a collision-free scene/payload path; The existing RoboTwin motion route is unchanged; this tool adds no scene or carried-object collision model. A boundary depth gap cannot distinguish leaked background from a true farther surface or thin handle; flagged pixels remain unresolved evidence, not semantic background exclusions.
On error: inspect a complementary current view and re-localize the same intended functional regions; do not treat unknown as verified. Keep phases separate: check before release, release with its own gripper command, check again after release, depart a short distance, then check once more. Receipt stage evidence must match the requested phase. Recompute after physical action; assessment_ref is only an audit reference, not a trajectory. Retention evidence is advisory; a verification call is not a prerequisite for closed-gripper motion.
Arm binding: every gripper command, retention check and placement check must name the intended arm, whichever calls this surface advertises for them. Opposite-arm opening does not release this object; opposite-arm motion is not this arm's exit. All candidates stale after any world action, including motion of the other arm. A successful gripper receipt says executed, not Cartesian reached; it is command completion, not physical release. geometry_status and measured checks are separate from stage_evidence and uncertainty_reasons. Unconfirmed action stage preserves valid geometric candidates; inspect their prerequisites and decide subsequent actions independently.
